## `neuro.date.setUTCDate`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Sets the numeric day of the month in the Date object using Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

## Signatures

```ts
setUTCDate(input: { date: <receiver>; date_arg: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.setUTCDate` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
